title: Smoky Russian Cauliflower Pilaf
description: A hearty and comforting vegetarian pilaf dish filled with smoky flavors, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cauliflower florets and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked pilaf, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-12 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
